conventions.angles: degrees unless the key ends in _arcmin/_arcsec
conventions.true_alt: geometric (vacuum) altitude above the observer's ellipsoid horizon (astropy, pressure=0)
conventions.comparison_sign: observed-minus-model: positive means the star was truly higher than the model's occlusion angle
conventions.seconds: residual divided by the star's altitude rate; the clock offset that would close the residual
conventions.frame: peak-anchored: origin at the peak foot, tangent plane at the peak. Planar x=u, z=h; globe x=(R+h)sin(u/R), z=(R+h)cos(u/R)−R, u = s − D
conventions.terrain: dtm = bare earth (primary; unsuffixed terrain comparisons), dsm = top of canopy (suffix _dsm, plus a canopy flag); per-event arrays in terrain/{id}.json
